text:
Before: roast chicken leg quarter plus slices, about 200 g edible, roughly 400 kcal. Baby potatoes, about 9 pieces, roughly 300 g, about 280 kcal with oil. Small loaf cake, about 50 g, about 180 kcal. Mixed vegetables, about 150 g, about 90 kcal. Gravy, about 250 ml, roughly 120 kcal.

After: everything is eaten except the bone. The gravy was mostly poured onto the plate and consumed, with some residue left; I estimate about 200 g eaten, about 100 kcal.

Totals: chicken 180 g/380 kcal, potatoes 300 g/280 kcal, cake 50 g/180 kcal, vegetables 150 g/90 kcal, gravy 200 g/100 kcal. That gives 880 g and 1030 kcal.
